title: An ascetic since yesterday, already with matted locks
literal_meaning: Yesterday’s ascetic—matted locks already on the head.
meaning_odia: ଅଳ୍ପଦିନର ଅନୁଭବ ଥାଇ ମଧ୍ୟ ବହୁଦିନର ଅଭିଜ୍ଞ ଲୋକ ପରି ବଡ଼ କଥା କହିବା ବା ଚିହ୍ନ ଦେଖାଇବା। ନୂଆ ଯୋଗୀଙ୍କ ମୁଣ୍ଡରେ ଜଟାର ଚିତ୍ର ଦେଇ ଅଭିଜ୍ଞତା ପୂର୍ବରୁ ତାହାର ଆଡ଼ମ୍ବରକୁ ପ୍ରଶ୍ନ କରାଯାଇଛି।
explanation: The source applies the saying to an inexperienced person making grand claims. The joke lies in the timing: someone has only just taken on a role, yet already displays a sign associated in the image with long practice. The appearance has arrived ahead of the experience.
usage_example: After one introductory class, someone begins presenting themselves as a seasoned expert. A friend recalls the saying to question the inflated claim. This illustration is newly composed.
cultural_context: The public gloss treats matted locks on a newly become ascetic as a suspect shortcut to an established appearance. The verse uses that compressed contrast to make premature authority visible.
